description.narrative: British Red Cross multilateral support to Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement (RCM) disaster risk management (DRM) initiatives in 2026–2027 will strengthen collective preparedness, anticipatory action, and response capacity at global and regional levels. Funding will support Movement‑wide DRM mechanisms and initiatives, including contributions to the IFRC Disaster Relief Emergency Fund (DREF), Preparedness for Effective Response (PER), and the Disaster and Crisis Working Group, alongside other agreed RCM DRM priorities. These investments enable coordinated risk reduction, faster and more effective emergency response, and shared learning across National Societies. This funding channel will be used to allocate FCDO, Disaster Fund, and ELS resources to priority Movement‑wide DRM programmes and initiatives.
